sources.label: Free-time patches for apps
sources.author: RabehX
patch_list: Stops the app from detecting Developer Options, USB debugging or debuggable flags, removing the blocking security dialog.
Improves compatibility with debugging tools. Covers the Dart maps scan, the VdoCipher native marker and the rjsniffer port scanner.
Short-circuits Google Play Integrity with "DISABLED", retains original APK v1/v2 signatures, and spoofs app integrity checksum/signature checks.

Forces every root, jailbreak, emulator, hook and mock-location check to report a clean device across Java/Kotlin, Dart AOT, RootBeer, SafeDevice, VdoCipher and rjsniffer native probes, and removes the isolated Magisk sniffer service.
Makes the Dart SPKI validator return its own success value, so the app's public key pinning no longer rejects intercepted TLS connections. Covers arm64-v8a and x86_64; armeabi-v7a keeps pinning.

Disables analytics, crash reporting, performance monitoring, surveys and advertising attribution while keeping push notifications and Remote Config. Stops CleverTap, Qualtrics, Adjust, Facebook App Events, VdoCipher telemetry, Firebase Ana…
Spoofs PackageManager signing certificate queries with the original Play Store certificate via Morphe's signature extension. Requires an unmodified stock APK.
